scope: Slack conversations.replies was queried from the handoff cutoff for every known saved pre-cutoff thread root in the exact approved campaign. The separately approved active public roster contained a retained post-cutoff reply found by the same method. Parent absence in all 160 channels was separately provider-checked. This evidence does not cover an unsaved parent root, future activity, or completion of all polling fallback windows. The 160 roster is quiet and archived; active near-live Events proof comes from the separate 20 public channels.
